data.name: Lutfana
data.gender_notes: Lutfana is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'lutf' which means 'to be gentle, compassionate, and generous'. In Islamic tradition, Lutfana represents a gentle, kind, and loving soul. The name is often used for girls who are expected to embody these qualities in their lives. The name Lutfana carries the meaning “Graceful, Sweet, Lovely” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Lutfana usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful, sweet, lovely and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name infused with grace and love, symbolizing the compassionate nature of Allah.
data.etymology: Lutfana belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Graceful, Sweet, Lovely.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Lutfana total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
